SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
                 pipeline_session_id AS resource_id
             FROM product_pipeline_sessions WHERE project_id=$1::uuid AND pipeline_session_id=$2::uuid AND created_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY created_at DESC, pipeline_session_id DESC LIMIT $3::int;

SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
                 artifact_id AS resource_id, artifact_sha256
             FROM stage_artifacts WHERE project_id=$1::uuid AND pipeline_session_id=$2::uuid AND created_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY created_at DESC, artifact_id DESC LIMIT $3::int;

SELECT to_char(decided_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
                 gate_id AS resource_id, decision, target_artifact_id, target_artifact_sha256
             FROM stage_approval_gates WHERE project_id=$1::uuid AND pipeline_session_id=$2::uuid AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
              ORDER BY decided_at DESC, gate_id DESC LIMIT $3::int;

SELECT to_char(frozen_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS recorded_at,
